title: Which evidence satisfies which requirement?
prompt: Place each artefact with the requirement it evidences.

pairs.item: A document outlining business and technical requirements for each agent.
pairs.why: That is the stated proof of completion for gathering requirements with the end user.

pairs.item: A session with a Glean technical resource covering agent structure and best practices followed.
pairs.why: Each agent requires an architecture review with a Glean technical resource.

pairs.item: A written explanation of impact and why a Glean Agent was the best solution.
pairs.why: Reviewed by a Glean Partner Solutions Engineer.

pairs.item: Five completed technical courses in the Glean Partner Portal.
pairs.why: A Glean Partner Manager validates this requirement.

takeaway: Every requirement has a named proof of completion and a named validator.
